title: Signal Layer
claim: SROW begins with immediate orientation so a reader can identify the subject before sustained attention is required.

title: Structural Layer
claim: SROW makes the major parts of material visible before extended explanation.

title: Meaning Layer
claim: SROW delivers the core explanation and essential terms without unnecessary expansion.

title: Expansion Layer
claim: SROW adds implications and distinctions after the core meaning is established.

title: Immersion Layer
claim: SROW supports bounded application once orientation, structure, meaning, and expansion are in place.
